title: Backflow preventer serial number: find the record that makes service traceable
description: A serial number supports asset traceability when present, but it does not replace the model, size, device type, location, and service history.
prompt: How should a serial number be used in a backflow asset record?
answer: A serial number supports asset traceability when present, but it does not replace the model, size, device type, location, and service history. Keep all identifiers together so a future test or repair can be matched correctly.
urgency: Escalate a missing or unreadable label when a repair kit or replacement decision depends on exact identity.
diagramAlt: Backflow service and compliance workflow reference
identifiers: Record serial number with manufacturer, model, nominal size, and site location.
